items.work: Fantasía bética · Homenaje ‘Pour le tombeau de Claude Debussy’ · Cuatro piezas españolas — piano works
items.label: Hyperion, CDA68177
items.note: Falla’s piano music in one programme, recorded at St Silas the Martyr, Kentish Town, in November 2016. Roger Nichols’s booklet note hears reminiscences of Debussy’s La soirée dans Grenade at the end of the Homenaje.

items.label: Signum Classics, SIGCD404
items.note: The piece as Falla first wrote it, for solo guitar, in the album Homages, recorded in January 2012 and released in October 2014. It runs three minutes forty-one seconds.
